## Key Clinical Services
- Orthopedic Physiotherapy (Back Pain, Neck Pain, Knee Pain, Shoulder Pain, Slip Disc, Sciatica)
- Neurological Rehabilitation (Stroke Recovery, Paralysis, Parkinson's Disease, Spinal Cord Injury, Balance Disorders)
- Sports Physiotherapy (ACL Rehab, Muscle Strains, Ligament Sprains, Return-to-Sport Protocols)
- Paediatric Physiotherapy (Cerebral Palsy, Developmental Delays, Birth Injuries)
- Women's Health Physiotherapy (Pregnancy Back Pain, Pelvic Floor Recovery, Post-Partum Care)
- Home Visit Physiotherapy (In-home care across Dehradun with portable electrotherapy equipment)
- Post-Surgery Rehabilitation (Knee Replacement, Hip Replacement, ACL Surgery, Spinal Surgery)
- Pain Management (Non-pharmacological management for chronic back, neck and joint pain)
